Third-party code served from this site
======================================

These two files are vendored so that notebook pages make no request to a third
party (cdn.jsdelivr.net is unreliable from mainland China, and a notebook page is
the page a student opens when their Codespace will not connect). Quarto's Jupyter
engine adds them to any notebook page with an HTML or JavaScript output; they are
only needed for JavaScript and Jupyter-widget output.

scripts/selfhost_assets.py rewrites the rendered pages to load them from here,
and `uv run python scripts/selfhost_assets.py --check` (run in CI) verifies the
files below are byte-for-byte what is recorded. Each file keeps its own licence
banner at the top, which is the copyright and licence notice for a minified file.

jquery-3.5.1.min.js
  Library:  jQuery 3.5.1
  Licence:  MIT (https://jquery.org/license)
  Upstream: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jquery@3.5.1/dist/jquery.min.js
            (npm package "jquery", file dist/jquery.min.js)
  SHA-256:  f7f6a5894f1d19ddad6fa392b2ece2c5e578cbf7da4ea805b6885eb6985b6e3d
  Copyright (c) JS Foundation and other contributors.

require-2.3.6.min.js
  Library:  RequireJS 2.3.6
  Licence:  MIT (https://github.com/requirejs/requirejs/blob/master/LICENSE)
  Upstream: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/requirejs@2.3.6/require.min.js
            (npm package "requirejs", file require.js, minified by jsDelivr)
  SHA-256:  08820fe928391c47d804d54b5ee8f07f7c1eda5df6ab5da99c3c32b494563962
  Copyright jQuery Foundation and other contributors.

Both files are the exact versions Quarto 1.11.9 references, and their SHA-384
digests were confirmed equal to the integrity values Quarto writes into its pages.
